superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da zadržim Connectorovo zajedničko vreme prijema: Sensor.Community sada pokazuje 12 min, a Parking Servis 7 min, pri čemu potonji i dalje ne daje vreme merenja. Takođe odbacujem navodno preklapanje naslova Danasa i Studija B kao aktuelni dokaz: njihovi najnoviji naslovi tiču se penzionisanja vojnih funkcionera i medijskog spora, a ne zajedničkog izveštaja o Čupiću. [F10][F11][F14][F15]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot preserve Connector's shared reception timing: Sensor.Community now shows 12 min and Parking Servis 7 min, and the latter still supplies no measurement time [F10][F11]. I also reject the claimed Danas–Studio B headline overlap as current evidence: their latest titles concern military retirements and a media dispute, not a shared Čupić report [F14][F15].
